results.title: Fix: Unsafe Code Loading from User Input Could Execute Malicious Programs in scrapy/commands/genspider.py
results.extractability_reason: The required behaviour is stated: untrusted user input must no longer be able to load arbitrary code via importlib.import_module().
results.accepted_requirement: The system shall prevent arbitrary code execution from untrusted user input.

iteration_history.candidate: If user input is passed to importlib.import_module(), then the system shall validate or restrict the input to prevent loading arbitrary code.

issues: The requirement specifies a mechanism ('validate or restrict') rather than the required behaviour. The evidence supports preventing arbitrary code loading, but does not specify the technique.
The requirement is conditional on user input being passed to importlib.import_module(), but the underlying obligation is to prevent arbitrary code execution regardless of implementation details.
unsupported_claims: validate or restrict (implementation techniques not specified in the evidence)
revision_instructions: Remove the conditional phrasing 'if user input is passed to importlib.import_module()' and the mechanism reference ('validate or restrict'). Replace with the abstract behaviour the evidence supports: preventing the execution or loading of arbitrary code from untrusted input.
Rephrase to focus on the outcome (prevented arbitrary code execution) rather than the specific function or validation technique.

iteration_history.candidate: The system shall prevent arbitrary code execution from untrusted user input.

results.title: Fix: Unsafe XML Processing Library Could Allow Malicious Attacks in scrapy/http/request/rpc.py
results.extractability_reason: The required behaviour is stated: xmlrpc usage must be replaced with defusedxml.xmlrpc to prevent malicious XML attacks.
results.accepted_requirement: When processing XML-RPC requests, the system shall use defusedxml.xmlrpc instead of xmlrpc.

iteration_history.candidate: When processing XML-RPC requests, the system shall use a defused XML library to prevent malicious XML attacks.

issues: The requirement specifies 'XML-RPC requests' as the scope, but the evidence indicates the change is in the request handling module, not necessarily limited to processing incoming requests. The actual behaviour may be broader or differently scoped.

The requirement uses 'defused XML library' as a specific implementation choice, but the evidence only supports the abstract behaviour of preventing malicious XML attacks. The mechanism (library choice) should not be named in a functional requirement.
unsupported_claims: the specific use of 'defused XML library' (implementation detail)
the scope limited to 'XML-RPC requests' is not clearly defined in the evidence
missing_information: Whether the change applies to all XML processing in the module or only XML-RPC specifically
Whether this applies to request creation, processing, or both
revision_instructions: Remove the reference to 'defused XML library', which is an implementation choice. State instead what malicious XML attacks the system must prevent, or use the abstract term 'safe XML processing'.
Clarify the scope: specify whether this applies to XML-RPC processing in general, or to a specific operation such as request creation or handling.

iteration_history.candidate: When processing XML-RPC, the system shall prevent malicious XML attacks.

issues: The requirement abstracts away from the specific mechanism mentioned in the Pull Request. The evidence indicates a switch from xmlrpc to defusedxml.xmlrpc, but the requirement does not ground this change in a concrete behaviour.
The requirement uses a vague phrase 'malicious XML attacks' without specificity. The Pull Request identifies a vulnerability class but does not detail which attacks are prevented.
missing_information: The specific library change from xmlrpc to defusedxml.xmlrpc is not reflected in the requirement, though it is the core action of the PR.
The specific vulnerability or attack class (if any) that defusedxml.xmlrpc protects against, beyond the general category of 'malicious XML attacks'.
revision_instructions: Reframe the requirement to describe the behaviour of using defusedxml.xmlrpc for XML-RPC processing, rather than the abstract goal of preventing attacks. The mechanism is the supported fact here.

Replace 'malicious XML attacks' with a more specific characterization if the Pull Request evidence supports it, or keep it general but ensure the requirement states what the system does, not what it prevents.

iteration_history.candidate: When processing XML-RPC requests, the system shall use defusedxml.xmlrpc instead of xmlrpc.
